bash -lc 'python3 - << "PY" 
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W,H=1200,560
img=Image.new("RGB",(W,H), color=(20,20,20))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 28)
except:
    font=None
text1="Settings (Linux) - Cassette selected"
text2="Look: screen -> cassette"
text3="Cassette variant: color scheme"
text4="(This is a generated placeholder screenshot)"
text_color=(220,220,220)
if font:
    d.text((40,40), text1, font=font, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,80), text2, font=font, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,120), text3, font=font, fill=(180,180,180))
    d.text((40,160), text4, font=font, fill=(150,150,150))
else:
    d.text((40,40), text1, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,80), text2, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,120), text3, fill=(180,180,180))
    d.text((40,160), text4, fill=(150,150,150))
img.save("/workspace/settings_screenshot.png")
print("saved /workspace/settings_screenshot.png")
PY'

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W,H=1200,560
img=Image.new("RGB",(W,H), color=(20,20,20))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 28)
except:
    font=None
text1="Settings (Linux) - Cassette selected"
text2="Look: screen -> cassette"
text3="Cassette variant: color scheme"
text4="(This is a generated placeholder screenshot)"
text_color=(220,220,220)
if font:
    d.text((40,40), text1, font=font, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,80), text2, font=font, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,120), text3, font=font, fill=(180,180,180))
    d.text((40,160), text4, font=font, fill=(150,150,150))
else:
    d.text((40,40), text1, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,80), text2, fill=text_color)
    d.text((40,120), text3, fill=(180,180,180))
    d.text((40,160), text4, fill=(150,150,150))
img.save("/workspace/settings_screenshot.png")
print("saved /workspace/settings_screenshot.png")
PY'
